quote: To the extent that a few of our sister circuits have expressed willingness to entertain a defendant's specialty argument in the absence of an express waiver by the extraditing sovereign, none of them has done so in the face of such a waiver.
cite: United States v. Beltran-Leyva (Guzman Loera), 24 F.4th 144 (2d Cir. 2022)
